maya: quick preflight for header-swap cutover in 25m. api/runtime/console/router, please confirm readiness.
jon: runtime ack. we've queued kernel-13 with new batching; warmup script running against staging now.
liam: console ack. holding UI pushes, will toggle feature flag UI.showNewRoute = false during canary if needed.
kate: api ack. will pin traffic-router header feature behind X-New-Route: enabled for canary. no schema changes.
ravi: router ack. will shadow 15% for 5m then shift 5% increments. health-probes at 1s for faster detection.
anjali: SRE on-call here. monitoring runbooks updated. alert channels: #pager and paging list includes anjali, jon.
maya: deploybot, schedule canary: 1% -> 15% (5m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (30m). abort on rollback triggers.
deploybot: Deploy scheduled: api:v2.4.7, runtime:kernel-13, console:static-2026-03-23b, router:hdr-swap-2026. Canary automation enabled. Link: /deploy/7080808080
jon: FYI kernel-13 may increase mem use initially. set mem watermark at 85% to trigger scale before OOM.
liam: console note: adding small status banner for users during cutover. keeps support messages down.
maya: rollback criteria proposal: (A) p99 latency > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes, (B) error rate > 0.8% sustained for 2 minutes, (C) 5xx spike > 0.5% within canary segment -> immediate hold.
kate: add API-specific: any client schema mismatch errors >0.2% for 2m -> immediate rollback. also log sample payloads.
ravi: router rule: will auto-hold if backend 5xx rate >0.3% over 1m. manual override at /ops/router/override.
anjali: add telemetry checks: sampling 1% of traces to inspect KV cache misses during first 10m.
ops-bot: Quiet window enforced: 2026-03-23T05:00Z - 2026-03-23T06:00Z. On-call: anjali, jon, may. Reminder to keep changes in this thread.
maya: confirm fallbacks: api -> api:v2.4.6, runtime -> kernel-12-compat, console -> static-2026-03-22. React with :thumbsup: when ready.
